title: Rank-size analysis of optimal portfolio weights with a reverse-engineering application
abstract: arXiv:2611.34171v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper investigates the shape of optimal portfolio weights using rank-size analysis. We consider four portfolio selection models: Global Minimum-Variance (GMV), minimum-CVaR, Risk Parity (RP), and the Most Diversified Portfolio (MDP). For each model, we fit seven rank-size specifications to the sorted portfolio weights generated over rolling windows. To compare the fitted specifications, we combine standard goodness-of-fit measures with Cumulative Second-order $\varepsilon$-Stochastic Dominance, an $\varepsilon$-parameterized generalization of Second-order Stochastic Dominance that quantifies the extent to which the exact dominance conditions are satisfied or violated. Empirically applied to major equity indices, this approach provides a systematic criterion for identifying the optimal functional form across diverse market compositions. translated_title: 最优投资组合权重的排序-规模分析及其逆向工程应用
translated_abstract: 本文利用排序-规模分析研究最优投资组合权重的形态。我们考虑了四种投资组合选择模型：全局最小方差组合（GMV）、最小CVaR组合、风险平价组合（RP）以及最分散化组合（MDP）。对于每个模型，我们将七种排序-规模规格拟合到在滚动窗口上生成的排序后组合权重上。为了比较拟合的规格，我们将标准的拟合优度度量与累积二阶ε-随机占优相结合，后者是二阶随机占优的ε参数化推广，可以量化精确占优条件被满足或违背的程度。该方法实证应用于主要股票指数，为在不同市场构成下识别最优函数形式提供了系统性准则。此外，我们还解决了从观测到的组合权重逆向识别生成模型的反问题。
tldr: 本文通过对四种最优投资组合模型进行排序-规模分析，并结合累积二阶ε-随机占优作为拟合优度准则，建立了识别最优权重分布函数形式的系统方法，并进一步实现了从观测权重逆向推断生成模型的反问题求解。
en_tdlr: This paper applies rank-size analysis to four optimal portfolio selection models, combining goodness-of-fit measures with cumulative second-order ε-stochastic dominance to systematically identify optimal functional forms across markets, and further reverse-engineers the generating model from observed portfolio weights.
